quotes.name: Swift Justice
quotes.flavor:
"Having conviction is more important than being righteous."
—Aurelia

quotes.name: Shivan Oasis
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks: Phyrexia vs. the Coalition
quotes.flavor: Only the hardiest explorers survive to eat the fruit.

quotes.name: Humility
quotes.flavor:
"One cannot cleanse the wounds of failure."
—Karn, silver golem

quotes.name: Creeperhulk
quotes.flavor:
"I saw the devastation when the juggernauts crashed the walls of An Karras. Then I got to thinking."
—Janji, sylvan druid

quotes.name: Fauna Shaman
quotes.flavor: She wears the talismans of every creature she can evoke.

quotes.name: Embereth Shieldbreaker // Battle Display
quotes.flavor: "Courage is the only shield I need."

quotes.name: Monastery Swiftspear
quotes.flavor:
"No sign of movement. Looks like we've got the element of sur—"
—Gaiza, Mardu raider

quotes.name: Life Insurance
quotes.flavor: All the money in the world won't buy back a pulse.

quotes.name: Constricting Sliver
quotes.flavor: Slivers are often seen toying with enemies they capture, not out of cruelty, but to fully learn their physical capabilities.

quotes.name: Lavabelly Sliver
quotes.flavor: Warm enough to incubate eggs or incinerate those who would eat them.

quotes.name: Bogbrew Witch
quotes.flavor: "The hardest thing is finding the right ingredients."

quotes.name: Barad-dûr
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor:
"Those who pass the gates of Barad-dûr do not return."
—Gandalf

quotes.name: Ichor Wellspring
quotes.flavor:
"Our glorious infection has taken hold."
—Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite

quotes.name: Evolution Sage
quotes.set_name: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander
quotes.flavor: "To care for yourself, cultivate the world. To care for the world, cultivate yourself."

quotes.name: Avatar of Slaughter
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor:
"Diplomacy has solved nothing. Only bloodspill can end this now. Call forth the warbringer."
—Basandra, Battle Seraph

quotes.name: Talisman of Progress
quotes.flavor:
"Thus is the friendship of the Mark and of Gondor bound with a new bond, and the more do I rejoice."
—Éomer

quotes.name: Wolf in _____ Clothing
quotes.flavor: "And to think, I came in here looking for someone to eat."

quotes.name: Sidequest: Hunt the Mark // Yiazmat, Ultimate Mark
quotes.flavor: Legend says it is an Anima, guardian to a sacred blade. Though most sacred amongst its kind, its great power drove it to madness, and in the end, it became a threat to its own creator.

quotes.name: Urban Evolution
quotes.flavor: As the Simic released more of their krasis experiments, they required new habitats, always at the expense of the locals.

quotes.name: Platinum Angel
quotes.flavor:
"Serra built angels from the spirits of fallen warriors, but I believe a more mundane power source might suffice."
—Karn

quotes.name: Phyrexian Hulk
quotes.flavor:
"They are convenient in having no souls, but less so in having no spirit."
—Volrath

quotes.name: Meteor Golem
quotes.flavor: The impact sent the soldiers scattering—then something came out of the crater.

quotes.name: Relic of Progenitus
quotes.flavor: Elves believe the hydra-god Progenitus sleeps beneath Naya, feeding on forgotten magics.

quotes.name: Poetic Ingenuity
quotes.flavor: "You inspire me."

quotes.name: Apex of Power
quotes.flavor:
"As I desire, so it shall be."
—Nicol Bolas

quotes.name: Epiphany at the Drownyard
quotes.flavor:
"Is this what you found, Tamiyo?"
—Jace Beleren

quotes.name: Search for Azcanta // Azcanta, the Sunken Ruin
quotes.flavor: The Sunken Ruin houses all the learning of a long-forgotten age.

quotes.name: Primordial Sage
quotes.flavor: For each creature that arrives in its audience, the sage imparts another piece of ancient wisdom for all to hear.

quotes.name: T'Chaka, Venerable King
quotes.flavor: "I am king of Wakanda. A line unbroken. A crown unconquered."

quotes.name: Drumhunter
quotes.flavor: "I feel the vine-rhythm as my friends drive the beast to me. I will not miss my mark."

quotes.name: Giada, Font of Hope
quotes.flavor: The source of the Cabaretti's Halo turned out to be a single teenage girl.

quotes.name: Lunarch Mantle
quotes.flavor:
"A boon from the angels should never be cast aside."
—Manfried Ulmach, Chief Inquisitor

quotes.name: Cold-Eyed Selkie
quotes.flavor: She follows the old tributaries built when merrows still shaped the tides.

quotes.name: Kiora's Follower
quotes.flavor: "She may call herself Kiora but I believe she is Thassa, the embodiment of the sea and empress of the depths."

quotes.name: Vector, Imperial Capital
quotes.flavor:
"If we allow the Empire to continue expanding its Magitek arsenal... history's greatest mistake will be repeated."
—Banon, Leader of the Returners

quotes.name: Treasure Vault
quotes.set_name: Adventures in the Forgotten Realms Promos
quotes.flavor: There is wealth enough inside to cause the rise and the ruin of dynasties.

quotes.name: Bloodshot Cyclops
quotes.flavor: After their first encounter, the goblins named him Chuck.

quotes.name: Pit Fight
quotes.flavor:
"All the coins in Ravnica can't save his soul now."
—Narbulg Nine Fingers

quotes.name: Suppression Ray // Orderly Plaza
quotes.flavor: The Consulate's aether spotlights have a setting to incapacitate trespassers on contact.

quotes.name: Tangleclaw Werewolf // Fibrous Entangler
quotes.flavor:
"What has long, flesh-rending claws and enormous, bone-crushing teeth?"
—Halana, Kessig ranger

quotes.name: Goblin Ringleader
quotes.flavor:
*Goblin_Chieftain:* sweet filter!!1! #gobmob
*Thrun_TheLastTroll:* lol glad i wasn't there

quotes.name: Living Lightning
quotes.flavor: Not all storms come from the sky.

quotes.name: Pitiless Gorgon
quotes.flavor: "The reign of the Swarm begins. Let us rise now and dress ourselves in vengeance."

quotes.name: Graveyard Shovel
quotes.flavor: Thanks to Havengul's thriving illegal market for corpses, the shovel that interred a body during the day is usually the same one digging it out at night.

quotes.name: Underdark Basilisk
quotes.flavor:
"See how the statues all have chunks bitten out of them? We're dealing with a basilisk, or I'm a froghemoth."
—Larissa Kyriln, learned warlock

quotes.name: Wolf Cove Villager
quotes.flavor: Life is simply slower in the snow. Nobody knows that better than the villagers of Wolf Cove.

quotes.name: Krovikan Elementalist
quotes.flavor:
"The Elementalists' talents could be useful if turned to other purposes."
—Zur the Enchanter

quotes.name: Morbid Opportunist
quotes.flavor: On Innistrad, one person's windfall usually starts with another person lying face down in the mud.

quotes.name: Graceful Reprieve
quotes.flavor: "In my moment of death, I had a vision of the world, dark and unwelcoming. I wanted to hide in the deepest meander, but the light pulled me back."

quotes.name: Anarchist
quotes.flavor: Those who will not follow are doomed to lead.

quotes.name: Fodder Cannon
quotes.flavor: Step 1: Find your cousin. Step 2: Get your cousin in the cannon. Step 3: Find another cousin.

quotes.name: Redwood Treefolk
quotes.flavor:
"In the heart of Llanowar the magic is so strong that trees cannot stay rooted."
—Mirri of the *Weatherlight*

quotes.name: Angelic Blessing
quotes.flavor: A peasant can do more by faith than a king by proclamation.

quotes.name: Primalcrux
quotes.flavor: When nature is backed into a corner, just like its children, it lashes out.

quotes.name: Jund Panorama
quotes.flavor: The sky is the dragon's throne, the seat from which it issues its fiery decrees.

quotes.name: Tainted Isle
quotes.flavor: The island's signal tower protected it from mirelurks but did nothing against the raiders.

quotes.name: Karakas
quotes.flavor: "To make a prairie it takes a clover and one bee,/ One clover, and a bee,/ And revery." —Emily Dickinson

quotes.name: Farseek
quotes.flavor: Eumidians live to change and be changed, ever increasing the complexity of the Edge. Each new world is a new perspective.

quotes.name: Otherworldly Journey
quotes.flavor:
"The landscape shimmered and I felt a chill breeze. When my vision cleared, I found myself alone among the corpses of my fallen friends."
—Journal found in Numai

quotes.name: Sandsteppe Citadel
quotes.flavor: The houses and the holes of Shire-Hobbits were often large, and inhabited by large families. Sometimes many generations of relatives lived in comparative peace together in one ancestral and many-tunneled mansion.

quotes.name: Crimson Honor Guard
quotes.flavor: The finest soldiers aren't worth a whit without a set of hands to lead them and a set of eyes to guide them.

quotes.name: Glimmer of Genius
quotes.flavor: Dr. Madison Li's genius was an asset for both Project Purity and, later, the Institute.

quotes.name: Birds of Paradise
quotes.flavor: Long ago, birds of paradise littered the skies. Thanks to the city's sprawl, most now exist as pets of society's elite.

quotes.name: Jolrael, Mwonvuli Recluse
quotes.flavor: "Humans bring nothing but suffering and deceit. They are not welcome in my forest."

quotes.name: Mine Bearer
quotes.flavor: "The Keldons may have explosive tempers, but *I* have explosives."

quotes.name: Anguished Unmaking
quotes.flavor: James flooded the room with radiation, ensuring Project Purity would not fall into Enclave hands. With his last breath, he told his child to run.

quotes.name: Jalira, Master Polymorphist
quotes.flavor: "You can become anything if I just put my mind to it."

quotes.name: Voice of Victory
quotes.flavor: "Come crackling spear, come beating wing! Come cavalier, come taut bowstring!"

quotes.name: Ionize
quotes.flavor: "Countermagic is a simple process of breaking matter into its elementary particles."

quotes.name: Finale of Revelation
quotes.flavor: "Brother, your fate has always been bound to mine. Now we have reached the place where they shall both end."

quotes.name: Jungle Wurm
quotes.flavor: Broad as a baobab—and about as smart.

quotes.name: Kaalia of the Vast
quotes.flavor: "I'll have my revenge if I have to call on every force from above and below."

quotes.name: Bishop's Soldier
quotes.flavor: Vampires, the noble class of old Torrezon, are guided by their dual loyalties to church and crown.

quotes.name: Skewer the Critics
quotes.flavor: Going to a Rakdos show is dangerous. Trying to leave early can be fatal.

quotes.name: Loran of the Third Path
quotes.flavor: As a scholar, she saw the sylex not as a weapon, but as a key to the past.

quotes.name: Edgar, Moonlit Sovereign
quotes.flavor: Innistrad's moonlit nights belong to his pack and his pack alone.

quotes.name: Eternal Witness
quotes.flavor: WITNESS ME AS I WITNESS YOU

quotes.name: Guardians of Akrasa
quotes.flavor:
"Only by the bravery of those who put loyalty above glory is our home kept safe."
—Elspeth Tirel

quotes.name: Escape from Orthanc
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor:
"How far can you bear me?" asked Gandalf.
"Many leagues," said Gwaihir, "but not to the ends of the earth. I was sent to bear tidings, not burdens."

quotes.name: Air Response Unit
quotes.flavor: Wherever the racers go, help follows.

quotes.name: Aura Shards
quotes.flavor: Nothing is truly broken if you knock it over with intent.

quotes.name: Rumbling Aftershocks
quotes.flavor:
"I like it here. You always get a little more for your mana."
—Chandra Nalaar

quotes.name: Tradewind Rider
quotes.flavor: It is said that the wind will blow the world past if you wait long enough.

quotes.name: End-Raze Forerunners
quotes.flavor:
"Smash this city to pieces."
—Domri Rade

quotes.name: Rafiq of the Many
quotes.flavor: Many sigils, one purpose.

quotes.name: Living Destiny
quotes.flavor: "That our enemies are great only brings us greater hope."

quotes.name: Food Fight
quotes.flavor: With no time to gather weapons, the dwarves fought the redcaps with anything within reach.

quotes.name: Arcane Teachings
quotes.flavor: Dwarves may teach at the speed of stone, but their results are solid.

quotes.name: Steeple Roc
quotes.flavor:
"Sometimes it forgets to loosen its grip before taking flight. I lost my roof that way."
—Ecaban, Boros scout

quotes.name: Leonin Arbiter
quotes.flavor: "Our people are torn by infighting. Until the two sides reconcile, our laws can carry no meaning."

quotes.name: Crypt Angel
quotes.flavor: Once an angel, now an abomination.

quotes.name: Carnivorous Death-Parrot
quotes.flavor: Save a kill spell to deal with this guy.

quotes.name: Ayara, First of Locthwain
quotes.flavor: Mourning shifts seamlessly to celebration as she chooses her next suitor.

quotes.name: Spirit Summoning
quotes.flavor:
"Books are fantastic, but if you're really curious about the distant past, why not ask someone who was there?"
—Augusta, Lorehold dean

quotes.name: Isildur's Fateful Strike
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor: Isildur cut the Ring from Sauron's hand with the hilt-shard of his father's sword, and Sauron himself was overthrown.

quotes.name: Obelisk of Grixis
quotes.flavor: Like most features of Grixis, the obelisks that remain from the time of Alara now exist only for dark exploitation.

quotes.name: Faerie Swarm
quotes.flavor: Untouched by the Aurora, Oona's faeries greeted the night like any other day.

quotes.name: Frenzied Raptor
quotes.flavor: Sun Empire warriors are taught to emulate the fearless raptors that fling themselves against towers of horn and muscle a hundred times their size.

quotes.name: Dracogenesis
quotes.flavor:
"Let the dragonstorms rage. Let what seeks sustenance feed. Let Tarkir be what it was always meant to be."
—Sarkhan

quotes.name: Baleful Strix
quotes.flavor: Its beak rends flesh and bone, exposing the tender marrow of dream.

quotes.name: Doomed Traveler
quotes.flavor: He vowed he would never rest until he reached his destination. He doesn't know how right he was.

quotes.name: Qarsi High Priest
quotes.flavor: "Hear me, nameless, and obey."

quotes.name: Localized Destruction
quotes.flavor: Imperial detonators are calibrated to maximize devastation while minimizing collateral damage.

quotes.name: White Sun's Zenith
quotes.flavor: After the Battle of Liet Field, the white sun crested above Taj-Nar, bringing hope to all who survived the carnage.

quotes.name: Abrade
quotes.flavor: The desert is a voracious beast, devouring both flesh and stone.

quotes.name: Ancient Animus
quotes.flavor: Multani's mind grasped for consciousness as rage itself rebuilt his body.

quotes.name: Sword of the Animist
quotes.flavor:
"My heart rejoices; for you, Estel, shall be among the great whose valor will destroy the Shadow."
—Arwen

quotes.name: Invoke the Winds
quotes.flavor:
"Are you seriously telling me your heavy combat mech . . . blew away?"
—Risona, leader of the Asari Uprisers

quotes.name: Naturalize
quotes.flavor:
"When your cities and trinkets crumble, only nature will remain."
—Garruk Wildspeaker

quotes.name: Goblin Rally
quotes.flavor: You don't so much hire goblins as put ideas in their heads.

quotes.name: Call of the Ring
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor: "The Ring is mine!"

quotes.name: Teshar, Ancestor's Apostle
quotes.flavor: "The Ancestor saved us for a purpose."

quotes.name: Brotherhood's End
quotes.flavor:
"Two strong wills, one wake of destruction."
—*The Antiquities War*

quotes.name: Atomwheel Acrobats
quotes.flavor:
"If the acrobatic show doesn't wow the audience, we have no one to blame but our elves."
—Myra the Magnificent

quotes.name: Foul Imp
quotes.flavor: The villagers call it "winged stench."

quotes.name: Scavenging Ooze
quotes.flavor: In nature, not a single bone or scrap of flesh goes to waste.

quotes.name: Ardent Militia
quotes.flavor:
"While the rest of us got paid to serve the Benalish army, the militia didn't. I used to say they stood for freedom—free *and* dumb."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

quotes.name: Lurching Rotbeast
quotes.flavor: The dead that swept across Naktamun came in all shapes and sizes.

quotes.name: Subjugator Angel
quotes.flavor: The remnants of Innistrad's corrupted angelic hosts collapsed to form the Flight of Nightmares.

quotes.name: Battle-Rattle Shaman
quotes.flavor: The shaman rattles not to inspire a battle fury but to drown out the shrieks of those fleeing the Eldrazi.

quotes.name: Snuff Out
quotes.flavor: "The bigger they are, the faster they rot."

quotes.name: Rakdos Signet
quotes.flavor: Made of bone and boiled in blood, a Rakdos signet is not considered finished until it has been used as a murder weapon.

quotes.name: Stensia Bloodhall
quotes.flavor: The revelry ends when the supply of fresh ingenues runs dry.

quotes.name: Blade Sliver
quotes.flavor: After breaking free from the Riptide Project, the slivers quickly adapted to life on Otaria—much to the dismay of life on Otaria.

quotes.name: Cabaretti Courtyard
quotes.flavor: So long as the Halo keeps flowing, the festivities never end.

quotes.name: Lena, Selfless Champion
quotes.flavor: "Those who do evil and those who do nothing are equally worthy of contempt."

quotes.name: Rogue's Passage
quotes.flavor: Rumors quickly spread among thieves about a labyrinth without walls and a prize beyond all measures of worth.

quotes.name: Falkenrath Noble
quotes.flavor: "I often think on how excited they must feel to be chosen as my prey."

quotes.name: Dancing Scimitar
quotes.flavor: Bobbing merrily from opponent to opponent, the scimitar began adding playful little flourishes to its strokes; it even turned a couple of somersaults.

quotes.name: Morbid Plunder
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks: Mirrodin Pure vs. New Phyrexia
quotes.flavor: Even the dead are raw materials for the Phyrexian vision of perfection.

quotes.name: Insidious Dreams
quotes.flavor: Chainer dreams of ultimate knowledge.

quotes.name: Aether Gale
quotes.flavor: The militia formed up in the central plaza awaiting the onslaught, but the giants never quite made it.

quotes.name: Thirst for Knowledge
quotes.flavor: "Knowledge is the universal currency of the Multiverse. It is power. It is freedom. It is possibility itself."

quotes.name: Skyshroud Falcon
quotes.flavor:
The falcon slits the sky to let the light drip through.
—Kor saying

quotes.name: White Knight
quotes.flavor: Out of the blackness and stench of the engulfing swamp emerged a shimmering figure. Only the splattered armor and ichor-stained sword hinted at the unfathomable evil the knight had just laid waste.

quotes.name: Scapeshift
quotes.flavor:
"Whether we like it or not, our arrival has altered the landscape."
—Malcolm, navigator of the *Belligerent*

quotes.name: Tuinvale Treefolk // Oaken Boon
quotes.flavor: "Right now you are a feeble stick, but I will help you grow some rings."

quotes.name: Cecil, Dark Knight // Cecil, Redeemed Paladin
quotes.flavor: "This is my battle, one I must fight alone to atone for my wrongs."

quotes.name: Skyhunter Cub
quotes.flavor: Every young leonin wishes to become a skyhunter, for they soar closest to the suns.

quotes.name: Blood Price
quotes.flavor: Blood is the oldest currency.

quotes.name: Benalish Honor Guard
quotes.flavor:
"The true measure of all heroes is not what they achieve, but who they inspire."
—*Triumph of Gerrard*

quotes.name: Leonin Arbiter
quotes.flavor: "Our people are torn by infighting. Until the two sides reconcile, our laws can carry no meaning."

quotes.name: Loxodon Warhammer
quotes.flavor:
"A crafter must imbue her weapon with part of her soul—something the Phyrexians are incapable of doing."
—Melira

quotes.name: Wickerbough Elder
quotes.flavor: "Living scarecrows make a mockery of the natural order. Dead ones make fine hats."

quotes.name: Balmor, Battlemage Captain
quotes.flavor: "Even the most hardened armies are ill-equipped to defend against an onslaught from the sky."

quotes.name: Ultimate Price
quotes.flavor:
"Let him be an example to others who would default on their debts to us."
—"The Cozen," Orzhov assassin

quotes.name: Lathliss, Dragon Queen
quotes.flavor: If she commands it, her subjects will burn the world to ash.

quotes.name: Shu Elite Companions
quotes.flavor: Throughout the three kingdoms, important generals were often guarded by small groups of expert soldiers known as "elite companions."

quotes.name: Scattered Groves
quotes.flavor: Awaiting harvest around the Groves family cabin are plump pumpkins, hearty carrots, juicy mutfruit, and ravenous scorchbeasts.

quotes.name: Duress
quotes.flavor: "Change your mind, or I'll change it for you."

quotes.name: Quicksilver Dagger
quotes.flavor: The dwarves call their quicksilver techniques "improvisational weaponsmithing."

quotes.name: Tempered Sliver
quotes.flavor: The question isn't whether slivers will adapt to a world's perils but whether the world's perils will adapt to slivers.

quotes.name: Dreamstone Hedron
quotes.flavor: Only the Eldrazi mind thinks in the warped paths required to open the hedrons and tap the power within.

quotes.name: Soul Warden
quotes.flavor: She is sworn to the wayward spirits, just as they are sworn to her.

quotes.name: Swarm Intelligence
quotes.flavor: The Locust God's children were numberless, relentlessly eating away every trace of the city's protection.

quotes.name: Test of Faith
quotes.flavor: Those who survive the test bear a mark of power anyone can recognize.

quotes.name: Telepathy
quotes.flavor: "Secrets? What secrets?"

quotes.name: Fleetfeather Sandals
quotes.flavor:
"The gods gave us no wings to fly, but they gave us an even greater gift: imagination."
—Daxos of Meletis

quotes.name: Armored Pegasus
quotes.flavor: Asked how it survived a run-in with a bog imp, the pegasus just shook its mane and burped.

quotes.name: Shuttle Ace
quotes.flavor: Although she was a Kelpien, a prey species, she feared no predator once behind the controls.

quotes.name: Masked Admirers
quotes.flavor: "Beauty determines value, and we determine beauty."

quotes.name: Skeleton Archer
quotes.flavor:
"When it comes to killing with precision, a soul is but a hindrance."
—Isareth the Awakener

quotes.name: Kird Ape
quotes.flavor: It puts the "fur" in "fury."

quotes.name: Shorecrasher Mimic
quotes.flavor: The Aurora replaced the changelings' innocence with malice and their curiosity with hunger.

quotes.name: Painful Truths
quotes.flavor: As the Eldrazi spread, no secret that could give Zendikar's defenders an advantage was considered too dangerous to seek.

quotes.name: Blurred Mongoose
quotes.flavor:
"The mongoose blew out its candle and was asleep in bed before the room went dark."
—Llanowar fable

quotes.name: Lingering Souls
quotes.flavor: The murdered inhabitants of Hollowhenge impart to the living the terror they felt in death.

quotes.name: Raise the Alarm
quotes.flavor: "The nim raid our homes without warning. We must defend our homes without hesitation."

quotes.name: Starstorm
quotes.flavor: Ever since the disaster, the city's survivors viewed the star-strewn sky with dread.

quotes.name: Abyssal Specter
quotes.flavor: To gaze under its hood is to invite death.

quotes.name: Urban Daggertooth
quotes.flavor: Stop, smell the roses, eat the peoples.

quotes.name: Arbor Adherent
quotes.flavor:
"Many hands make light work! Or two hands and a trunk, as the case may be."
—Sanzar, Kin-Tree Warden

quotes.name: Patriarch's Bidding
quotes.flavor:
"Family plots are so convenient."
—Cabal Patriarch

quotes.name: Predation Steward
quotes.flavor:
"Best we move on. That gurgling means it's feeding time."
—Melira

quotes.name: Foreboding Ruins
quotes.flavor: When the Great Rift opened across the Galaxy, many Imperial worlds were lost to Chaos.

quotes.name: Leaping Ambush
quotes.flavor: Witchstalkers have extremely powerful legs—all the better to reach you with.

quotes.name: Valley Rotcaller
quotes.flavor: "Fighting the snake is to fight starvation itself. Strikes synchronize with hunger pangs."

quotes.name: Mirozel
quotes.flavor: The mirozels are the only stars in Rath's opaque skies.

quotes.name: Skullclamp
quotes.flavor:
"My mother's name is Jenova... 'The Jenova Project'... is this just a coincidence?"
—Sephiroth

quotes.name: Sharuum the Hegemon
quotes.flavor: To gain audience with the hegemon, one must bring a riddle she has not heard.

quotes.name: Rumor Gatherer
quotes.flavor: "It's delightful, the things their owners reveal when they think no one is listening."

quotes.name: Seedship Impact
quotes.flavor: A new brood finds its home on the doorstep of another's.

quotes.name: Lost Leonin
quotes.flavor: Mirrans were broken down and rebuilt, made to be loyal servants of the force they had fought.

quotes.name: Retreat to Coralhelm
quotes.flavor: Their Enclave overrun, the merfolk took refuge within beauty.

quotes.name: Geometer's Arthropod
quotes.flavor:
"Creatures that have survived blood-soaked millennia should not be underestimated."
—Nev, dean of substance

quotes.name: Juggernaut
quotes.flavor: The mighty city of An Karras, with its rich history, built over thousands of years, fell in three hours.

quotes.name: Misleading Motes
quotes.flavor: Yarvis was almost certain he'd seen the same tree an hour ago, but then again, didn't all trees look alike? He shelved his doubts and followed the friendly, twinkling motes deeper into the forest.

quotes.name: Naturalize
quotes.flavor: "From here, let the world be reborn."

quotes.name: Magister Sphinx
quotes.flavor: "These benighted worlds are thick with ignorance. I will educate them. They will listen, or they will die."

quotes.name: Warmonger's Chariot
quotes.flavor: The best defense is a good offense.

quotes.name: Villainous Wealth
quotes.flavor: Gold buys death. Death earns gold.

quotes.name: Gigantic Big Bear
quotes.flavor: Wargs and Goblins had few predators in the foothills of the Misty Mountains, but they did have some.

quotes.name: Thirst for Discovery
quotes.flavor: I knew he had left the castle now, and thought to use the opportunity to explore more than I had dared to do as yet.

quotes.name: Shacklegeist
quotes.flavor: The Blessed Sleep doesn't come easily to a mind chained by regrets.

quotes.name: Aether Hub
quotes.flavor: It powers the dreams of Ghirapur.

quotes.name: Merfolk Seastalkers
quotes.flavor:
"Do they seek knowledge or wealth? Are they bandits or benefactors? It depends on who is chanting the tale."
—Nikou, Joraga bard

quotes.name: Scattered Groves
quotes.flavor:
"Just because you have ravaged your natural resources and paved over your forests, do not think we have made the same mistake."
—King T'Chaka, to the United Nations

quotes.name: Counterlash
quotes.flavor: "Pathetic. Let me show you how it's done."

quotes.name: Graft Surgeon
quotes.flavor: When medical supplies are limited, her own cuttings will suffice.

quotes.name: Thriving Bluff
quotes.flavor: Throughout the ages Mount Wundagore has yielded wonders, supernatural and scientific, sacred and profane.

quotes.name: Hand That Feeds
quotes.flavor: In the darkness, Lana reached for Shay's hand and squeezed it for comfort. Then she heard Shay call to her from the next room.

quotes.name: Liquimetal Coating
quotes.flavor:
"They'll soon become accustomed to wearing skin that is not their own."
—Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite

quotes.name: Eye of Ugin
quotes.flavor: Droplets of an idea pool, until the dam breaks and the flood is unleashed.

quotes.name: Caves of Koilos
quotes.flavor: After years of silence, the caves once again echo with the grisly sounds of Phyrexians preparing for war.

quotes.name: The Sixth Doctor
quotes.flavor: "This is a situation that requires tact and finesse. Fortunately, I am blessed with both!"

quotes.name: Dark Favor
quotes.flavor: When he began to curse what he held holy, his strength grew unrivaled.

quotes.name: Grixis Charm
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks: Ajani vs. Nicol Bolas
quotes.flavor:
"So many choices. Shall I choose loathing, hate, or malice today?"
—Eliza of the Keep

quotes.name: Sonic Screwdriver
quotes.flavor: The Doctor's technologically advanced tool helps them out in most situations.

quotes.name: Spiketail Hatchling
quotes.flavor: It dodges waves of water to prepare for waves of magic.

quotes.name: Codecracker Hound
quotes.flavor: Even across the Edge, a dog is still a dog.

quotes.name: Valley Dasher
quotes.flavor: Mardu riders' greatest fear is that a battle might end before their weapons draw blood.

quotes.name: Body Dropper
quotes.flavor: "Kill count? I lost track years ago."

quotes.name: Rootha, Mercurial Artist
quotes.flavor: "Art is never finished. Merely abandoned."

quotes.name: Seek the Wilds
quotes.flavor: "In my downtime I used to paint the vistas. Now the vistas disappear faster than my downtime."

quotes.name: Isolation Zone
quotes.flavor: When properly aligned, hedrons become powerful tools of binding.

quotes.name: Cragganwick Cremator
quotes.flavor: Each night that his bowl fills, a village mourns.

quotes.name: Infectious Horror
quotes.flavor: Not once in the history of Grixis has anyone died of old age.

quotes.name: Midnight Reaper
quotes.flavor: No one welcomes his visit, yet all must grant him tribute.

quotes.name: Ridge Rannet
quotes.flavor:
"Only those with the strength to seize their destiny deserve to have one."
—Nacatl scratchforms

quotes.name: Rix Maadi, Dungeon Palace
quotes.flavor: Even miles away, if you put your ear to the sewer vents, you can hear the screams and the tempestuous laughter.

quotes.name: Odric, Master Tactician
quotes.flavor: "Fear holds no place in faith's battle plan."

quotes.name: Whispering Wizard
quotes.flavor: Ivold was aghast when his device revealed the full scope of the geist infestation.

quotes.name: High Market
quotes.flavor: If it can't be had here, it can't be had on any world.

quotes.name: Tobias, Doomed Conqueror
quotes.flavor: Tobias spent decades tormenting pirates on the open sea and decades more dancing lifelessly beneath it.

quotes.name: Eternal Scourge
quotes.flavor:
"It has latched onto this place like an infestation. All efforts at eradication have proved futile."
—Yeter, Trostad villager

quotes.name: Metastatic Evangel
quotes.flavor: "I am no sleeper agent. I am a liberator. It is you who are asleep."

quotes.name: Murasa Rootgrazer
quotes.flavor: Few other creatures so closely embody Murasa's rapid cycles of growth.

quotes.name: Time Warp
quotes.flavor: Just when you thought you'd survived the first wave.

quotes.name: Dream Leash
quotes.flavor: The tendrils of sorcery find easy purchase on the soft underbelly of dreams.

quotes.name: Command Tower
quotes.flavor: When defeat is near and guidance is scarce, all eyes look in one direction.

quotes.name: Empyrial Archangel
quotes.flavor: Her wings are the prayers of the devoted; her sword, the despair of the vile.

quotes.name: Lone Missionary
quotes.flavor: His mission has become a grim pilgrimage, a tour of the Eldrazi-stricken outposts across Zendikar. But he marches on alone, stubborn as the daily dawn.

quotes.name: Elven Cache
quotes.flavor:
"The elves can hide better than most can look."
—Mwani, Mtenda herder

quotes.name: Vilis, Broker of Blood
quotes.flavor: ALWAYS SLIPS A "TERMINATION" CLAUSE INTO THE FINE PRINT.

quotes.name: Serra Ascendant
quotes.flavor: "I laugh at gravity all the time. Hahaha, gravity."

quotes.name: Silent Departure
quotes.flavor: The same magic that lets geists pass through our realm can force them out of it.

quotes.name: Blood Seeker
quotes.flavor: He hopes each greedy gulp will be the one that makes him feel warm again.

quotes.name: Terrian, World Tyrant
quotes.flavor: The Fang Druids call it the World Tyrant, for it has consumed entire ecosystems that it keeps suspended in its core. To look upon it is to see the world as it was eons ago.

quotes.name: Durable Coilbug
quotes.flavor:
"I've seen them survive lava, trampling, and a moloch's digestive system. They just roll out and get on with their lives!"
—Gannet, Skysail zoologist

quotes.name: Darksteel Relic
quotes.flavor:
"It's the last thing we can call our own."
—Minhu, Mirran resistance

quotes.name: Windborn Muse
quotes.flavor:
"Her voice is justice, clear and relentless."
—Akroma, angelic avenger

quotes.name: Grounded for Life
quotes.flavor: "Of course I know what you did! You always do precisely what I told you not to do!"

quotes.name: Spider-Woman, Secret Agent
quotes.flavor: "I'm not friendly, and this isn't my neighborhood."

quotes.name: Whiskerquill Scribe
quotes.flavor:
"Unneeded words are like dandelion seeds—cast adrift at the slightest whiff of scrutiny, only to find purchase and thrive where you least expect."
—Myrtle, Valley scribe

quotes.name: Zephyr Net
quotes.flavor: Faeries hang beings that interest them as ornaments in the sky, each clique competing to outshine the prize of the last.

quotes.name: Fire Ants
quotes.flavor: Visitors to Shiv fear the dragons, the goblins, or the viashino. Natives fear the ants.

quotes.name: Gavony Unhallowed
quotes.flavor:
"We entered the church in search of solace, but it became clear we wouldn't find it there."
—Grete, Order of Saint Traft

quotes.name: Tenacious Hunter
quotes.flavor: The crocodiles of the Broken Lands, long used to feeding on undead flesh, eagerly flooded into Naktamun for a taste of something fresher.

quotes.name: Disenchant
quotes.flavor: The swarm seemed unmoved by the artificial slivers' destruction. "They clearly were not the leaders," Hanna cursed. "I guess we'll have to do this the hard way."

quotes.name: Sorcerous Sight
quotes.flavor: Do not react; anticipate.

quotes.name: Slimefoot, the Stowaway
quotes.flavor: As Jhoira restored the *Weatherlight*, a mushroom growing in its hold unexpectedly became her first crew member.

quotes.name: Temple of the False God
quotes.flavor:
"When gods become apathetic, the people will worship anyone who answers their pleas."
—Kiora

quotes.name: Shimian Night Stalker
quotes.flavor:
"When churchyards yawn and hell itself breathes out/ Contagion to this world."
—William Shakespeare, *Hamlet*

quotes.name: Master Splicer
quotes.flavor: Phyrexian artificers remove the flesh they no longer need and use it to bring their unholy creations to a greater semblance of life.

quotes.name: Primeval Shambler
quotes.flavor: His mind, like his body, is made up of the swamp's flotsam.

quotes.name: Soul Warden
quotes.flavor: "One does not question the size or shape of the grains of sand in an hourglass. Nor do I question the temperament of the souls under my guidance."

quotes.name: Golgari Signet
quotes.flavor: Depending on your point of view, the seal represents a proud guardian of the natural cycle or one who has sold her soul to darkness for eternal life.

quotes.name: Vampiric Tutor
quotes.flavor: True power is achieved through blood and sweat. But mostly blood.

quotes.name: Draconautics Engineer
quotes.flavor: "Gentlegoblins, start your dragons!"

quotes.name: Invasion Tactics
quotes.flavor:
"Your moment of truth isn't gonna be in front of some map. It's gonna to be out there on the battlefield."
—Aang

quotes.name: Dread Drone
quotes.flavor: Each Eldrazi ancient spawned a lineage of horrors in unfathomable shapes.

quotes.name: Scavenging Ooze
quotes.flavor: In nature, not a single bone or scrap of flesh goes to waste.

quotes.name: Bloodforged Battle-Axe
quotes.flavor: Spilled blood always begets more of the same.

quotes.name: Wary Watchdog
quotes.flavor: Valgavoth harbors a special loathing for dogs, whose mere presence provides a powerful antidote to the fear he craves.

quotes.name: Vengeance
quotes.flavor:
"Until I've gnawed their flesh and exterminated their clans, my humiliation will not be effaced."
—Liu Bei, on the death of his oath-brother Guan Yu

quotes.name: Target Minotaur
quotes.flavor: "Not again!"

quotes.name: High Tide
quotes.flavor:
"May Svyelun's waves drown your memory."
—Traditional merfolk curse

quotes.name: Lead Astray
quotes.flavor:
"Never underestimate our enemy's strength, brutality, . . . or stupidity."
—Commander Eesha

quotes.name: Gorilla Shaman
quotes.flavor:
"Frankly, destruction is best left to professionals."
—Jaya Ballard, task mage

quotes.name: Legion Vanguard
quotes.flavor: It takes guts to be a trailblazer.

quotes.name: The Sprinkler of Stardust
quotes.flavor: CREATURE

quotes.name: Staunch Defenders
quotes.flavor:
"Hold your position! Leave doubt for the dying!"
—Tahngarth of the *Weatherlight*

quotes.name: Patron of the Valiant
quotes.flavor: "Bant's most gallant knights wear my sigil, and for that I am humbled."

quotes.name: Sulfurous Springs
quotes.flavor: Everything is flammable in the Burning Isles, even the mana itself.

quotes.name: Unburden
quotes.flavor:
"Ambition requires clarity. If you have any doubts, they must be abandoned."
—Bontu, god of ambition

quotes.name: Yoked Ox
quotes.flavor:
It was in fields of grain, not fields of battle, that the Champion learned to bear the yoke of duty to the gods. She worked the land long before she was called on to defend it.
—*The Theriad*

quotes.name: Heroic Intervention
quotes.flavor: "I just want to do everything in my power to help. All of you... and the planet."

quotes.name: Goblin Chariot
quotes.flavor: The hardest part of his training is learning not to eat the boar.

quotes.name: Vizier of Remedies
quotes.flavor: "You'll need all your strength for the trials to come."

quotes.name: Shatterstorm
quotes.flavor: Chains of leaping fire and sizzling lightning laid waste the artificers' handiwork, sparing not a single device.

quotes.name: Vault Skyward
quotes.flavor:
"The edges of the Quicksilver Sea run dark with the spread of the Mephidross. Two more aerial passes before I can be sure what I'm seeing . . ."
—Lafarius, Neurok sky agent

quotes.name: Flaring Flame-Kin
quotes.flavor: A flame-kin is always formidable, but feeding its fire with a sorcerous gift grants it the power to devastate armies.

quotes.name: Wall of Air
quotes.flavor: "This 'standing windstorm' can hold us off indefinitely? Ridiculous!" Saying nothing, she put a pinch of salt on the table. With a bang she clapped her hands, and the salt disappeared, blown away.

quotes.name: Evolving Wilds
quotes.flavor:
"The wilds are unpredictable. Rivers change course, trees shuffle and bend, rocks split and scurry. But mark my words, traveler—the main thing that'll change out there is *you*."
—Sturwynn, Boundary Lands ranger

quotes.name: Yavimaya, Cradle of Growth
quotes.flavor:
"Multani's heart is a seed, and all of Yavimaya is its flower. There is as much life here as in the rest of Dominaria together."
—Karn

quotes.name: Baron Sengir
quotes.flavor:
"Beast. Defiler. The source of all my pain."
—Ihsan's Shade

quotes.name: Adventurous Impulse
quotes.flavor: An adventure without a companion is hardly an adventure at all.

quotes.name: Barkform Harvester
quotes.flavor: The farmers hide when it runs out of potatoes to harvest.

quotes.name: Wickerfolk Indomitable
quotes.flavor: Some horrors are created. Others are the recognition of a possibility that has always existed.

quotes.name: Driver of the Dead
quotes.flavor: Some vampires resorted to corpse trading after cathars burned their estates and drove them from their ancestral feeding grounds.

quotes.name: Escape to the Wilds
quotes.flavor: The guards kindled the hearth and locked the door to Ellwen's chamber. By morning, the fire was out and Ellwen was gone.

quotes.name: Scorched Rusalka
quotes.flavor: Each small blaze she sets jogs her memory, letting her piece together the mystery of her own fiery end.

quotes.name: Endless Cockroaches
quotes.flavor: There is nothing more repulsive than a cockroach—except a cockroach and all its friends.

quotes.name: Rhizome Lurcher
quotes.flavor:
"The dead gain new purpose here. What is strange in the eyes of other guilds is harmonious in ours."
—Devesh, Golgari shaman

quotes.name: Ghitu Fire-Eater
quotes.flavor: The Ghitu believe their race was born of fire, and it's an honor to return to it.

quotes.name: Xantid Swarm
quotes.flavor: When they land on you, all you can think about is tearing them off.

quotes.name: Elvish Archers
quotes.flavor: I tell you, there was so many arrows flying about you couldn't hardly see the sun. So I says to young Angus, "Well, at least now we're fighting in the shade!"

quotes.name: Odric, Master Tactician
quotes.flavor: "Fear holds no place in faith's battle plan."

quotes.name: Megrim
quotes.flavor:
"Pain is both a tool and a craft. Like any tool, it must be sharpened. Like any craft, it must be practiced."
—Hooks, Cabal torturer

quotes.name: Karlov Watchdog
quotes.flavor: Teysa trusts only those for whom money has no meaning.

quotes.name: Raise the Palisade
quotes.flavor:
"Did you not see the big 'No Soliciting' sign out front?"
—Iron Man, Tony Stark

quotes.name: Merry, Esquire of Rohan
quotes.flavor: Then suddenly Merry felt it at last, beyond doubt: a change. Wind was in his face!

quotes.name: Nephalia Smuggler
quotes.flavor: "My drivers are trustworthy. I removed their tongues myself. Any other questions?"

quotes.name: Thornwood Falls
quotes.flavor: Mere weeks later, the planet was scoured of any trace of life. Every scrap of vegetation, every drop of water—gone.

quotes.name: Persistent Petitioners
quotes.flavor:
"...we need seeds, yo."
"Lots of seeds, and..."

quotes.name: Caligo Skin-Witch
quotes.flavor: "Take their faces. The lips of these unbelievers may yet honor the Demonlord."

quotes.name: Sailor of Means
quotes.flavor: The rising tide of Orazca's plunder lifted all ships.

quotes.name: Roc of Kher Ridges
quotes.flavor: We encountered a valley topped with immense boulders and eerie rock formations. Suddenly one of these boulders toppled from its perch and sprouted gargantuan wings, casting a shadow of darkness and sending us fleeing in terror.

quotes.name: Piety
quotes.flavor:
"Whoever obeys God and His Prophet, fears God and does his duty to Him, will surely find success."
—*The Qur'an, 24:52*

quotes.name: City of Traitors
quotes.flavor:
"While we fought, the *il* surrendered."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

quotes.name: Vault of Whispers
quotes.flavor: Heretic cultists came to the planet Sovereign in search of resources and precious artifacts. They found something else.

quotes.name: Mana Reflection
quotes.flavor: The greatest wonders of nature are found in the smallest saplings straining toward the canopy.

quotes.name: Aetherize
quotes.flavor: No berzerker charge can stand against the psychic might of the Hive Mind.

quotes.name: Hidetsugu's Second Rite
quotes.flavor: Once a mortal ogre, Hidetsugu devoured his demonic patron and transcended mortality in a fit of rage.

quotes.name: Primal Order
quotes.flavor:
"My sorrow: to dream of simple times, and wake in mine . . . ."
—Ola DaRiol, "Regrets"

quotes.name: Terramorphic Expanse
quotes.flavor: The House's geography constantly warps and twists, fields melting into floorboards and walls opening into hungry maws.

quotes.name: Etali, Primal Storm
quotes.flavor: The storm rages and the earth breaks.

quotes.name: Merfolk Sovereign
quotes.flavor: "The sharks envy our ferocity. The eels envy our cunning."

quotes.name: Wei Strike Force
quotes.flavor: At the battle of Chang'an, Ma Chao defeated the two generals Cao Cao sent to guard the pass but was forced to flee when Cao Cao's trickery turned his own ally against him.

quotes.name: Wolverine, Fierce Fighter
quotes.flavor: "You picked the wrong dance partner, bub."

quotes.name: Basilisk Collar
quotes.flavor: During their endless travels, the mages of the Goma Fada caravan have learned ways to harness both life and death.

quotes.name: Tidecaller Mentor
quotes.flavor: "The same tides that bring us knowledge can sweep us away."

quotes.name: Bury in Books
quotes.flavor: There are no weapons allowed in the Biblioplex, but a clever mage is never truly defenseless.

quotes.name: Soul Snuffers
quotes.flavor: They once sought to unite with the flame of transcendence. Now they seek only to extinguish the lights of others.

quotes.name: Test of Faith
quotes.flavor: Those who survive the test bear a mark of power anyone can recognize.

quotes.name: Fecundity
quotes.flavor: Life is eternal. A lifetime is ephemeral.

quotes.name: Helm of Chatzuk
quotes.flavor: Whether inspired by fear or by honor, all loyalty lends might.

quotes.name: Subjugator Angel
quotes.flavor: The remnants of Innistrad's corrupted angelic hosts collapsed to form the Flight of Nightmares.

quotes.name: Basilisk Collar
quotes.flavor: A mark of companionship, not subservience.

quotes.name: Angelfire Ignition
quotes.flavor: "My angel is the flint, and I am her steel."

quotes.name: Infested Thrinax
quotes.flavor: Jund doesn't have a food chain so much as a mass feeding frenzy.

quotes.name: Omnispell Adept
quotes.flavor: She memorized every arcane text in the Ismeri Library by the time she was sixteen. Now she quizzes sphinxes in her spare time.

quotes.name: Bushmeat Poacher
quotes.flavor: "If you've never feasted on Zagoth terror-pig, I got the best price you'll find."

quotes.name: Patagia Golem
quotes.flavor: Its wings were only designed to be ornamental, but it learned to use them on its own.

quotes.name: Seasoned Warrenguard
quotes.flavor: Never underestimate what a rabbit can do with a root vegetable and some moxie.

quotes.name: Greater Mossdog
quotes.flavor: Man's best fungus.

quotes.name: Windurst, Federation Center
quotes.flavor: The first Star Sibyl gained the powers of the stars and moon at Full Moon Fountain. She found the stars of hope from within the darkness, and led Windurst to glory.

quotes.name: Ravages of War
quotes.flavor:
"Thorn bushes spring up wherever the army has passed. Lean years follow in the wake of a great war."
—Lao Tzu, *Tao Te Ching* (trans. Feng and English)

quotes.name: Spark Elemental
quotes.flavor: Vulshok shamans summon spark elementals to burn paths through thick underbrush—or through goblin salvage squads.

quotes.name: False Memories
quotes.flavor:
"My enemies will forget everything but their anguish."
—Ambassador Laquatus

quotes.name: Fact or Fiction
quotes.flavor: "Every choice is a joy."

quotes.name: Korvold, Fae-Cursed King
quotes.flavor: Transformed at his own wedding, he promptly ate the banquet, the gifts, and the guests.

quotes.name: On Thin Ice
quotes.flavor: He cursed the wind. He cursed the cold. But by stepping on the ice, he cursed himself.

quotes.name: Spontaneous Combustion
quotes.flavor: "Heat of battle" is usually a metaphor.

quotes.name: Crossbow Infantry
quotes.flavor:
"He can split a marshfly in two from halfway across the range."
—Onean sergeant

quotes.name: Thought Vessel
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: Infinite possibilities contained in a finite space.

quotes.name: Gigantomancer
quotes.flavor: "All life is driven by an indomitable will to survive. I simply turn that into something more . . . tangible."

quotes.name: Courier of Comestibles
quotes.flavor: Forgiveness is divine, but never pay full price for late pizza.

quotes.name: Haazda Marshal
quotes.flavor: Ravnica's convoluted power structure often boils down to who can muster the most swords on a given block.

quotes.name: Deepmuck Desperado
quotes.flavor: "Heard you've been horning in on my turf. How about I introduce you to some surf?"

quotes.name: Utter End
quotes.flavor:
"Target eradicated. That which burns shall ever be blessed."
—Fusilave unit Tor-213

quotes.name: Accumulated Knowledge
quotes.flavor: Building one's intelligence is like fishing for trouble. It's largely up to you whether a catch is made.

quotes.name: Rumbling Rockslide
quotes.flavor:
"When monsters walk, the earth knows its place and yields."
—Rielle, the Everwise

quotes.name: Admiral Beckett Brass
quotes.flavor: "You and your ship will make a fine addition to my fleet."

quotes.name: Kor Cartographer
quotes.flavor: Kor have no concept of exploration. They return to homelands forgotten.

quotes.name: Emeria Captain
quotes.flavor: "The gifts of the past must find their way into deserving hands."

quotes.name: Temple of Deceit
quotes.flavor: Vault-Tec's vaults, rather than being the savior of humanity, were actually a series of unethical psychological experiments.

quotes.name: Invisibility
quotes.flavor: Verick held his breath. Breathing wouldn't reveal his position, but it would force him to smell the goblins.

quotes.name: Sigil of the Empty Throne
quotes.flavor: When Asha left Bant, she ensured that the world would have protection and order in her absence.

quotes.name: Light of Day
quotes.flavor:
"I do not miss sunlight. The very memory of it burns my eyes."
—Volrath

quotes.name: Battleground Geist
quotes.flavor: Not content to nudge vases and chill drawing rooms, some geists muster spectral armies to claw at the hearts of the living.

quotes.name: Chain Reaction
quotes.flavor:
"Look, I don't know what happened. And I really wish I did, so I could do it again!"
—Tailpipe, Rocketeer

quotes.name: Shalai, Voice of Plenty
quotes.flavor: Miku's song lifts us all.

quotes.name: Homunculus Horde
quotes.flavor:
"*That* is why you triple-check all decimals when commissioning a new batch of homunculi!"
—Trigori, Azorius senator

quotes.name: Deny Existence
quotes.flavor: When all logical solutions fail, try an illogical one.

quotes.name: Divine Favor
quotes.flavor: With an armory of light, even the squire may champion her people.

quotes.name: Thriving Bluff
quotes.flavor: As eons passed, the rock wore away, revealing the rich colors at the mountain's heart.

quotes.name: View from Above
quotes.flavor: "This air feels so heavy and thick. There are no winds to speak of. I fear the knowledge that comes from a place like this."

quotes.name: Hunter's Prowess
quotes.flavor: To be counted among the warriors of Setessa's Leina Tower, you must not fear death, only failure.

quotes.name: Chandra's Outrage
quotes.flavor: Chandra never believed in using her "inside voice."

quotes.name: Deadbridge Goliath
quotes.flavor: Some Golgari insects live for centuries—and they never stop growing.

quotes.name: Stupefying Touch
quotes.flavor: "A warrior without wit is simply meat."

quotes.name: Heartwood Giant
quotes.flavor: Wind in the trees is soothing, but the same can't be said for trees on the wind.

quotes.name: Ainok Tracker
quotes.flavor:
"The ainok are wild dogs, not fit to join us around the fire."
—Surrak, the Hunt Caller

quotes.name: Worship
quotes.flavor:
"Believe in the ideal, not the idol."
—Serra

quotes.name: Emancipation Angel
quotes.flavor: "You have done your best. I give you leave to rest."

quotes.name: Embereth Skyblazer
quotes.flavor: "We fight with valor in our hearts and fire in our veins!"

quotes.name: Esper Origins // Summon: Esper Maduin
quotes.flavor: "I've chosen a name for her . . . Terra."

quotes.name: Overflowing Basin
quotes.flavor: Unfortunately for Vault 34's remaining residents, a battle over the armory resulted in flooding, a leaking reactor, and broken doors.

quotes.name: Angelic Page
quotes.flavor: If only every message were as perfect as its bearers.

quotes.name: Nahiri's Warcrafting
quotes.flavor: "Zendikar must be broken before it can be saved."

quotes.name: Brotherhood's End
quotes.flavor: The brothers' rivalry escalated into all-out enmity, and Tocasia paid the price.

quotes.name: Master Chef
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: You never thought "rations" was an appropriate term for the feasts you prepare for your party.

quotes.name: Defiant Ogre
quotes.flavor: "I have no clan, but I still have purpose."

quotes.name: Cloudshift
quotes.flavor:
"Clouds are made of water and air, so between the two of us, we ought to be able to bend them into any shape we want."
—Aang

quotes.name: Branchloft Pathway // Boulderloft Pathway
quotes.flavor:
"The path is stable. It's the gusts all around it that are a bit 'whoosh—oops—bye.'"
—Kreq of Sunder Bay

quotes.name: Crisis of Conscience
quotes.flavor: "Just touch these two strands together and the Daleks are finished. Have I that right?"

quotes.name: Wall of Kelp
quotes.flavor:
"Ya can eat it or ya can weave it, but ya can't fight in it."
—Zeki, Reef Pirate

quotes.name: Derelor
quotes.flavor:
"The derelor's greatest contribution to the Ebon Hand was the inspirational effect its creator's execution had upon the other thrull breeders."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. II*

quotes.name: Run Aground
quotes.flavor:
"That's the first time I've seen the ground do the running."
—Captain Brinely Rage

quotes.name: Cagemail
quotes.flavor:
"Power often costs too high a price."
—Commander Eesha

quotes.name: Open the Graves
quotes.flavor: It was a night like any other. It would soon become a night no one would ever forget.

quotes.name: Lakeside Shack
quotes.flavor: They say that if you stay in the cabin until the mists reach it, something will slither from the water and knock at the door.

quotes.name: Pest Summoning
quotes.flavor:
"Step 1: Put the pests in mud.
"Step 2: Wait."
—*Gyome's Guide to Pest Breeding*

quotes.name: Sphinx's Revelation
quotes.flavor: "Let the knowledge of absolute law inspire you to live a life of absolute order."

quotes.name: Zhuge Jin, Wu Strategist
quotes.flavor: When Zhuge Jin proposed the marriage of Guan Yu's daugher and Sun Quan's heir, Guan Yu's arrogant refusal led to disaster.

quotes.name: Spider-Rex, Daring Dino
quotes.flavor: On Earth-66, Pter Ptarker learned that with GRRRR power comes GRRAHHHsibility.

quotes.name: One with the Machine
quotes.flavor:
"When I grafted the Planar Bridge into myself I felt my Planeswalker spark flare beyond my body. The Multiverse was my plaything. It felt . . . incredible."
—Tezzeret

quotes.name: Duress
quotes.flavor:
"It hurts more if you think about it."
—Hooks, Cabal torturer

quotes.name: Revoke Existence
quotes.flavor:
"There will come a time when the gods will look at mortals and shudder."
—Uremides the philosopher

quotes.name: Mind Stone
quotes.flavor:
"Except our own thoughts, there is nothing absolutely in our power."
—Rene Descartes, *Discourse on Method*

quotes.name: Fetid Heath
quotes.flavor:
"Do not linger in such places, child. There the gwyllions dance. If they find you, you will join in their revels for eternity."
—Talara, elvish safewright

quotes.name: Errand of Duty
quotes.flavor:
"May they speed to their task, for the skyknights alone cannot hold Kjeldor safe."
—Arna Kennerüd, skycaptain

quotes.name: Peace of Mind
quotes.flavor:
Three are the paths of the soul:
One out—roam across the plain,
One back—dwell with tribe and tent,
One in—turn an enemy's hate.

quotes.name: Craw Wurm
quotes.flavor: The most terrifying thing about the craw wurm is probably the horrible crashing sound it makes as it speeds through the forest. This noise is so loud it echoes through the trees and seems to come from all directions at once.

quotes.name: Sacellum Godspeaker
quotes.flavor: Her connection to the gargantuans puts her in line to become Anima, a sacred but daunting duty.

quotes.name: Late to Dinner
quotes.flavor: "I knew you were set in your ways, friend, but even I didn't expect you to keep our engagement, under the circumstances."

quotes.name: Prairie Stream
quotes.flavor: Hunting mirelurks. Selling their eggs. It's not much, but it's honest work . . . for a raider.

quotes.name: Command Tower
quotes.flavor:
"Approach my tower on bended knee or depart from it as ash upon the wind."
—Gadwick, the Wizened

quotes.name: Keen-Eyed Curator
quotes.flavor: "Now this one's a real collector's item. They say Lily Emberseed herself drank from this mug when she was still Lily of Valley."

quotes.name: Stymied Hopes
quotes.flavor: When a god's will is against you, the day never ends well.

quotes.name: Ghostly Prison
quotes.flavor:
"May the memory of our fallen heroes ensnare the violent hearts of lesser men."
—Great Threshold of Monserkat inscription

quotes.name: Twisted Fates
quotes.flavor: "Josu's ashes choke you even now. You failed, while I will have our brother live forever," said one Liliana to the other.

quotes.name: Impostor Syndrome
quotes.flavor:
"I'm the real Spider-Man!"
"No, *I'm* the real Spider-Man!"

quotes.name: Quicksmith Rebel
quotes.flavor: "Let's add just a bit more stopping power."

quotes.name: Lightning Mare
quotes.flavor: When it passes, storm clouds bolt across the land.

quotes.name: Tegan Jovanka
quotes.flavor: "You certainly know how to fly this crate, don't you?"

quotes.name: Skymarch Bloodletter
quotes.flavor: "Looks like my Blood Fast is about to end early."

quotes.name: Rakdos Signet
quotes.flavor: Made of bone and boiled in blood, a Rakdos signet is not considered finished until it has been used as a murder weapon.

quotes.name: Buried Alive
quotes.flavor: The scrape of shovels and the tumble of cold dirt soon muffled their pleas.

quotes.name: Rimewind Cryomancer
quotes.flavor: "The Thaw brings flooding, disease, and death. We will do all in our power to bring frigid peace back to the world."

quotes.name: Tidings
quotes.flavor:
"Though the letter was many pages long, I could tell all I needed to know from one look at the messenger's face."
—Barrin, master wizard

quotes.name: Kessig Naturalist // Lord of the Ulvenwald
quotes.flavor: "Far from home, little one? I know the feeling."

quotes.name: Aberrant Researcher // Perfected Form
quotes.flavor: The final pages of the experiment log were blank. Investigators found it abandoned on a desk in the researcher's lab, open, the pages flipping in the wind from a shattered window.

quotes.name: Stormclaw Rager
quotes.flavor: No amount of spilled oil and crushed metal could slake her bloodlust.

quotes.name: Azorius Signet
quotes.flavor: The maze-like design embodies the core of Azorius law—strict structure designed to test wills and stall change.

quotes.name: Lightning Bolt
quotes.flavor:
"The first mages witnessed the fury of the raging storm and wished to answer back."
—*The Stormwright Texts*

quotes.name: Brink of Madness
quotes.flavor:
"The fools thought me dead. But I built an empire inside my tomb."
—Kerrick, sleeper agent

quotes.name: Okiba Reckoner Raid // Nezumi Road Captain
quotes.flavor: United by defiant pride in their outsider status, the nezumi of the Okiba Reckoners boast the most advanced cyberbikes and the best riders of all the Reckoner gangs.

quotes.name: Woodland Acolyte // Mend the Wilds
quotes.flavor: He left knighthood behind to heal the scars of the invasion.

quotes.name: Essence Warden
quotes.flavor:
"The more our numbers grow, the more I gain hope that Volrath and his cursed stronghold will one day fall."
—Eladamri, Lord of Leaves

quotes.name: Aladdin's Ring
quotes.flavor: "After these words the magician drew a ring off his finger, and put it on one of Aladdin's, saying: 'It is a talisman against all evil, so long as you obey me.'" —*The Arabian Nights*, Junior Classics trans.

quotes.name: Priest of Titania
quotes.flavor: Titania rewards all who honor the forest by making them a living part of it.

quotes.name: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty
quotes.flavor: "This is a tale to make all Kaldheim tremble..."

quotes.name: Riptide Director
quotes.flavor: Those who lead others to wisdom become the wisest themselves.

quotes.name: Persistent Petitioners
quotes.flavor: ". . . a decreased duration of synodic months would be most welcome. Also . . ."

quotes.name: Nin, the Pain Artist
quotes.flavor: "Your body is a delicate instrument that tells me truths. These devices help me 'tune' that instrument."

quotes.name: Reprocess
quotes.flavor: The battle's end is the meal's beginning.

quotes.name: Judge's Familiar
quotes.flavor:
"It misses nothing and it has no sense of humor."
—Barvisa, courtroom scribe

quotes.name: Mirari's Wake
quotes.flavor: The land drank power from the Mirari as though it had thirsted forever.

quotes.name: Mystic Snake
quotes.flavor: Its fangs are in your flesh before its hiss leaves your ears.

quotes.name: Cut a Deal
quotes.flavor: The beauty of Valley is born from the differences between animalfolk, not despite them.

quotes.name: Seal of the Guildpact
quotes.flavor:
"I'd rather see the guilds contend together with words in the halls of power, than in the streets with swords."
—Jace Beleren

quotes.name: Fell the Mighty
quotes.flavor:
"They had it coming."
—Squire Imalia, savior of Thiswick

quotes.name: Inspirit
quotes.flavor: "We will force the Cabal into their own pits!"

quotes.name: Consume Spirit
quotes.flavor:
"Your blood, your marrow, your spirit—all are mine."
—Mayvar, minion of Geth

quotes.name: Condemn
quotes.flavor:
"No doubt the arbiters would put you away, after all the documents are signed. But I will have justice *now*!"
—Alovnek, Boros guildmage

quotes.name: Fetid Imp
quotes.flavor: Many deaths are distasteful, but only a few are truly repugnant.

quotes.name: Crown of Fury
quotes.flavor: "Passion, fire my heart."

quotes.name: Old Gnawbone
quotes.flavor: The ancient green dragon Claugiyliamatar is often seen with a mangled corpse dangling from her mouth.

quotes.name: Thought-Knot Seer
quotes.flavor: It thinks, therefore you aren't.

quotes.name: Lagac Lizard
quotes.flavor: Tracing their ancestry back to Zendikar's earliest forms of life, lagac lizards have seen the comings and goings of planeswalkers and the Eldrazi, and the rise of the vampire clans, none of which has changed them one bit.

quotes.name: Jade Avenger
quotes.flavor:
"Froggy fighter at the gate.
Draw your sword and meet your fate."
—Traditional children's rhyme

quotes.name: Mild-Mannered Librarian
quotes.flavor: She had always believed in the transformative powers of great literature.

quotes.name: Goblin Balloon Brigade
quotes.flavor: "The enemy is getting too close! Quick! Inflate the toad!"

quotes.name: Fire Diamond
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: Every facet aglow like iron in Moradin's mighty forge.

quotes.name: Myr Moonvessel
quotes.flavor: Memnarch created the myr with three qualities in mind: dependability, controllability, and disposability.

quotes.name: Aesthir Glider
quotes.flavor: An ancient device recovered from a thawing glacier high in the Karplusan mountains.

quotes.name: Careful Study
quotes.flavor: It's late, but stopping now would break the rhythm.

quotes.name: Needle Storm
quotes.flavor: The rain is driven like nails.

quotes.name: Birds of Paradise
quotes.flavor:
"The gods used their feathers to paint all the colors of the world."
—Yare-Tiva, warden of Gramur Forest

quotes.name: Drake-Skull Cameo
quotes.flavor:
"A strange skull was turned up by an Ephran farmer's plow. I traded a copper ring for the 'ox skull.' It resonates of the sea and danger."
—Isel, master carver

quotes.name: Price of Glory
quotes.flavor:
"True strength lies in action. Let the weak react to me."
—Kamahl, pit fighter

quotes.name: Mitotic Manipulation
quotes.flavor:
"They can't even comprehend nature. How could they improve it?"
—Venser

quotes.name: Argentum Armor
quotes.flavor: Mirrodin's creator still lives, still shapes metal, and still commands world-shaking power.

quotes.name: Ruin Rat
quotes.flavor: From every shadow came the dull scratch of teeth on bones.

quotes.name: Pyrotechnics
quotes.flavor:
"Who says lightning never strikes twice?"
—Storm shaman

quotes.name: Selenia, Dark Angel
quotes.flavor:
"I am light. I am dark. I must give my life to serve; not even death can release me."
—Selenia, dark angel

quotes.name: Lock and Load
quotes.flavor: "Always bring a little extra thunder."

quotes.name: Teferi's Veil
quotes.flavor:
"I don't like to speak ill of 'walkers . . . but just what did Teferi think he was doing?"
—Ertai, wizard adept

quotes.name: Banewasp Affliction
quotes.flavor: Los muertos vivientes de Grixis aterrorizan a los supervivientes de Vithia, pero su fauna es igual de espantosa.

quotes.name: Loyal Warhound
quotes.set_name: Adventures in the Forgotten Realms Promos
quotes.flavor: A paladin's steed is a celestial spirit in animal form.

quotes.name: Gilt-Leaf Seer
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks: Nissa vs. Ob Nixilis
quotes.flavor: Desmera blinded her seers so that her beauty would be the last image burned in their memories. The act only deepened their insight.

quotes.name: Ukud Cobra
quotes.flavor:
"The Silumgar hide behind the deadly wildlife of their swamps. They'd rather scheme in their jungle palaces than face us."
—Khibat, Kolaghan warrior

quotes.name: Sudden Impact
quotes.flavor: Caught red-handed.

quotes.name: Jibbirik Omnivore
quotes.flavor: "Roadkill" takes on an entirely different meaning when the beast you crash into is more likely to kill *you*.

quotes.name: Winter Blast
quotes.flavor: "Blow, winds, and crack your cheeks! rage! blow!" —William Shakespeare, *King Lear*

quotes.name: Rubblebelt Raiders
quotes.flavor:
"This city will perish, and the Gruul will cheer as the boar-god crushes the last bricks into dust."
—Nikya of the Old Ways

quotes.name: Walking Desecration
quotes.flavor: Such sacrilege turns blinding grief into blinding rage.

quotes.name: The Peregrine Dynamo
quotes.flavor: Jhoira stumbled upon an ally, not just a good source of spare parts.

quotes.name: Scales of Shale
quotes.flavor: Like shedding, but backwards.

quotes.name: Green Dragon
quotes.flavor: Green dragons take special pleasure in corrupting the good-hearted.

quotes.name: Hour of Reckoning
quotes.flavor:
"Ravnica, like a hedge, must be pruned, leaving only leaves of verdant uniformity."
—Niszka, Selesnya evangel

quotes.name: Curious Altisaur
quotes.set_name: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander
quotes.flavor: After long days of squeezing through cramped tunnels, the Sun Empire's dinosaurs were overjoyed to stretch their necks and survey the wonders of the Core.

quotes.name: Kithkin Daggerdare
quotes.flavor: The kith dance their elaborate reels not merely to celebrate the events of their lives but to form an unbreakable bond of loyalty with their kin, a bond stronger than the fear of death itself.

quotes.name: Taurean Mauler
quotes.flavor: The power of a waterfall. The fury of an avalanche. The intellect of a gale-force wind.

quotes.name: Fiendlash
quotes.flavor: A fiery scourge for both flesh and soul.

quotes.name: Wild Griffin
quotes.flavor:
"I abandoned my dream of a squadron of griffin-riders when the cost proved too high. Three trainers were eaten for every griffin broken to the bridle."
—King Darien of Kjeldor

quotes.name: Nimble Brigand
quotes.flavor: The hard part wasn't sneaking aboard. It was safely exiting with Slickshot flair.

quotes.name: Seasoned Marshal
quotes.flavor:
"We are not interested in the possibilities of defeat."
—Queen Victoria

quotes.name: Mesa Enchantress
quotes.flavor: She shepherds mysteries and dust as others would a flock of sheep.

quotes.name: Hour of Reckoning
quotes.set_name: Phyrexia: All Will Be One Commander
quotes.flavor: Those who are chosen do not doubt. Those who remain do not lament.

quotes.name: Fertile Ground
quotes.flavor: As Phyrexians descended, Multani paused to reflect on the beauty that might never be seen again.

quotes.name: Stonewise Fortifier
quotes.flavor: Ephara taught some mortals to feel every vein in marble as though it flows with their own blood.

quotes.name: Sensory Deprivation
quotes.flavor: They call it "stitcher's anesthesia," a spell to deaden the senses while the mad doctors begin their grisly work.

quotes.name: Garrulous Sycophant
quotes.flavor:
"Marchesa's poison is delivered by more than daggers."
—Adriana, Captain of the Guard

quotes.name: Giant Badger
quotes.flavor: The wizard Greensleeves called a Giant Badger to her aid in an battle with the desert mage Karli.

quotes.name: Ostiary Thrull
quotes.flavor: Orzhov churches don't pass the plate for collection. They charge for admission.

quotes.name: Slash the Ranks
quotes.flavor: The generals each surveyed their devastated forces. Then, slowly, they turned to each other and raised their swords.

quotes.name: Deluge
quotes.flavor:
"From the sea came all life, and to the sea it will return. The sooner the better."
—Emperor Aboshan
